Familiar Superstitions.name: Familiar Superstitions
Familiar Superstitions.text:
Whispers of supernatural beings beyond our world. Even as a child, you must have heard some of them. And the way, now, that your familiar acts, it reminds you in ways of how the forces from those old folktales did. Perhaps these superstitions may give you some insight into the inscrutable goals of your patron and your relationship with your familiar... or perhaps it's your only way of understanding them.

Choosing a Superstition

Your superstition is based on unusual traits your familiar has—a conclusion drawn from the way they act, not vice versa. For example, a witch might see that their familiar resembles a flying eyeball and notice that it seems preoccupied with knowledge of the old ways before remembering old tales of ancient scholars with similar minions, this granting you the superstition of It Is Ever-Learning. From here, this witch would study magics that specifically link to these stories, and in turn their familiar. You cannot select more than one superstition, and they are chosen at level 1.

If your superstition would grant a familiar ability that your familiar already has naturally, you may select a replacement familiar ability instead of the one you would have gained. If you gain a specific familiar, you must have enough familiar abilities without including your superstition familiar abilities unless that specific familiar already possesses the familiar ability your superstition would grant.

Advanced Superstition

Your studies of your familiar have given you greater insight into their abilities. When you become 12th level, you gain the Advanced Superstition instead of the additional familiar ability you would receive at 12th level.

New Player Options.name: New Player Options
New Player Options.text:
Those that walk the path of allegiance to attain knowledge do so to meet appropriate ends, whether those allegiances be false, earnest, or dubiously accepted. Witches form bonds with entities, creatures, gods, devils, or even ideals, their magic bargained through amenable agreements with such parties in exchange for these allegiances. These lessons are provided by beings and entities whose power far outweighs their own, and yet, their potent nature empowers witches to perform powerful hexes and seemingly unnatural magic. These allegiances are offered as a wager of purpose, that the end goals of the patron match that of the sponsored.

New Patrons

A patron can be many things, although no two patrons share the same relationship with a witch, even if that patron might have more than one witch under their tutelage. A witch by the same measure, learns their lessons in a variety of ways, sometimes in spite of a patron's tutelage instead of resultant of it. Regardless of how the two parties negotiate their symbiosis, it is a mutually beneficial one carefully orchestrated through assistance from a familiar, preliminary teachings, and granted power. It might be somewhat cliché, but to say that a patron's exhibition in the life of a witch can be a blessing and a curse isn't far from the truth.

Hexmarked Witch.name: Hexmarked Witch
Hexmarked Witch.text:
Those that serve patrons are already known for binding themselves to the powers that be in strange ways, but some choose a different path. Patrons of these witches mark them for power, literally, granting them a visible manifestation of their patrons power. Such witches need not bother with conduits or messengers, they commune directly with the patron in a land of parley, a shared realm within the mind's eye that is made by agreed construction between witch and patron. The hexmarked know no world without a constant connection to their benefactor, though such a connection is not without its own secrets.

The Hexmarked Witch is a class archetype available for witches using Witches+.

To apply this class archetype, do the following:

  1. Give a player character the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classes.Item.bYDXk9HUMKOuym9h]{Witch} class.

  2. Delete the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.yksPhweBZYVCsE1A]{Familiar (Witch)} class feature from the player character.

  3. Add the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-features.Item.HOHcMF6HEMxs4idV]{Mark of the Patron} class feature to the player character.

Archetype Feats

The following feats are available to Hexmarked Witches:

  • 2nd Level @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-feats.Item.OWLoQyaiccx31RUv]{Hexmarked Witch Dedication} (mandatory)

  • 4th Level @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-feats.Item.aRMhMOPiKawUEqKb]{Hexmarked Object}, @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-feats.Item.ORQLEOYblvMaKcLO]{Marked Territory}
